cells.gaps: No source found reports a census counted since October 2016. Two sources disagree on preparation: on track in August 2024, and in July 2026 not launched because of political division.
cells.note: Preparation of the seventh census, with the country divided into census areas, is dated August 2024, inside three years, so stage 2. The July 2026 report that political division has prevented a new census being launched does not say none is being prepared, so it is not the stage 1 claim.
